mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_serial (material_id, serial_no, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{s.materialId}, #{s.serialNo}, #{s.warehouseId}, #{s.locationId}, #{s.batchNo}, #{s.status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_serial SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, location_id = #{locationId}, batch_no = #{batchNo}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.sql: sn.id, sn.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, sn.serial_no, sn.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, sn.location_id, l.code AS location_code, sn.batch_no, sn.status, sn.create_time, sn.update_time
FROM wms_serial sn JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = sn.material_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = sn.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = sn.location_id
